Tire + wheel packages

One visit, rolling out ready

A package pairs your wheels with matching tires so everything is mounted, balanced and checked together.

Pick the wheel

Choose a style, finish and diameter. Our team confirms it suits your vehicle.

Match the tires

Larger wheels usually mean a lower-profile tire, sized to keep the overall diameter close to stock.

Mount and balance

Tires go on the wheels and are balanced as an assembly, with the TPMS sensors handled.

Install and check

Wheels go on the vehicle, lug nuts are torqued to spec and fitment is checked.

Fitment check

What we check before a wheel goes on

A wheel that looks right can still rub, miss the brakes or sit crooked. Here is what our team looks at. This is a general guide, not a guarantee for any specific wheel.

1 · Bolt pattern

The number of lugs and the circle they sit on, written like 5x114.3. It has to match the vehicle exactly.

2 · Offset

How far the wheel face sits from the centerline, in millimeters. It sets how far the wheel and tire stick out or tuck in.

3 · Clearance

Room for brake calipers, suspension parts and fenders at full turn and full suspension travel, especially with wider tires or a lift.

4 · Center bore and load

The center hole should fit the hub, and the wheel and tire should be rated for the vehicle's weight.

Fitment guarantee terms: Simon to confirmNo promise is made here until the shop writes the terms.
Building it bigger?

Lift or level, then fit the wheels

Larger wheels and tires often go hand in hand with a lift or leveling kit. We can plan both together.

Lift kits and leveling Custom wheel service
Questions

Wheel FAQ

Can I put any wheel on my vehicle?

No. The bolt pattern, offset, center bore and clearance all have to work with your vehicle. That is why our team checks fitment before ordering.

Do bigger wheels change my tires?

Yes. A larger wheel usually takes a tire with a shorter sidewall. The goal is to keep the overall tire diameter close to stock so the speedometer and gearing stay accurate.

Will my TPMS sensors work with new wheels?

The sensors can often be moved to the new wheels or replaced. Our team will go over the options when you ask for a quote.

Can I pay over time?

Lease-to-own financing is available through Kafene. Terms are set by the provider, so see the financing page for how to apply.

Your vehicle

How is it mostly driven?

Generic intervals only. Always follow your owner's manual first.

Enter your mileage and pick how you drive to see a checklist of what to ask about.

Safety first. If a light comes on together with smoke, a burning smell, a loud noise, a soft brake pedal or the vehicle driving differently, pull over where it is safe and call for help. This guide cannot tell you it is safe to keep driving.
Dashboard lights

What the light usually means

Colors vary by vehicle, so check the owner's manual. As a rule, red means stop safely and get help, and amber or yellow means have it checked soon.

Light on and not sure?

Have a technician inspect it. A warning light is a starting point, and the cause can only be found with testing on the vehicle.

Schedule an inspectionCall (954) 773-1896
Good to know

Before you rely on a guide

Is this a diagnosis?

No. These pages explain what lights and intervals generally mean. A technician has to inspect and test the vehicle to find the real cause.

Which schedule should I follow?

Your owner's manual. It lists intervals set by the manufacturer for your exact vehicle. The checklist here is only a conversation starter.

Can I get this checked at my location?

Tire installation, balancing, repairs and oil changes can be done by our mobile team. Inspections that need a lift or alignment equipment happen at the Sunrise shop.

      Rebate how-to

      How manufacturer rebates work

      1. Ask which rebates are activeManufacturers change their programs often. Tell us the tires you are considering and we will check what applies.
      2. Buy and keep your invoiceYour itemized invoice is usually the proof the manufacturer asks for. Keep the paper or a photo of it.
      3. Submit the manufacturer's formEach brand has its own claim form and deadline. We will point you to the current one. Confirm exact steps with Simon.
      4. Watch for your rewardThe manufacturer, not the shop, issues the rebate. Timing and format are set by the brand. Confirm wording with Simon.

      Questions

      Financing FAQ

      What can I use it for?

      The shop offers Kafene for tires, wheels and service. Confirm exactly what is covered with Kafene or the team before you apply.

      Does the shop set the terms?

      No. Kafene sets the terms and makes the decision. We cannot promise approval or quote what an agreement will cost.

      Will applying affect my credit?

      We cannot say. Kafene's application and its disclosures explain what they check, so read them before you submit.

      Can I get a quote first?

      Yes. Request a quote and we will confirm pricing for your vehicle, then you can decide whether to apply.

      Does it work for mobile service?

      Ask us. Tell the team you plan to use Kafene when you book, and we will confirm how it works for your visit.

      Who do I contact about my agreement?

      Kafene manages your agreement, so contact them for payment or account questions. For anything about your tires or service, call us.

        1. Our commitment

        Extreme Tires wants everyone to be able to find tire, wheel and service information and to request a quote or appointment. We are working to make this website usable by people with a wide range of abilities and assistive technologies.

        2. Standards and target

        Our target is to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. This is a goal, not a certification: [target — verify via independent audit].

        3. What we are doing

        • Keyboard-operable navigation, forms and dialogs, with visible focus.
        • Headings, landmarks and labels intended for screen readers.
        • Text contrast and resizable text; motion that respects reduced-motion settings.
        • Alternative text for meaningful images.

        Items above describe design intent for the prototype and need confirmation in an audit. [Attorney to complete]
